# dsm_system_settings (Data Source)

Read-only data source exposing the DSM system date and time settings, including the NAS clock as DSM currently reports it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dsm_system_settings" "current" {}

output "nas_timezone" {
  value = data.dsm_system_settings.current.timezone
}

output "nas_clock" {
  value = "${data.dsm_system_settings.current.current_date} ${data.dsm_system_settings.current.current_time}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `current_date` (String) Date on the NAS as DSM reports it, in DSM's own `YYYY/M/D` form without leading zeros (for example `2026/8/12`).
- `current_time` (String) Time of day on the NAS as `HH:MM:SS`. This is a reading taken when the data source was refreshed, not a setting.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier of this singleton data source (`system_settings`).
- `ntp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the NAS clock is synchronised with an NTP server.
- `ntp_server` (String) Configured NTP server. DSM keeps the last value even while synchronisation is off.
- `timestamp` (Number) NAS clock as a Unix timestamp at the moment the data source was refreshed.
- `timezone` (String) DSM time zone name, for example `Moscow`. Synology's own naming, not an IANA identifier.
